articles.summary: Barrons.com: Cathie Wood Is Selling Tesla. Here’s the Chip Stock She’s Buying.. Cathie Wood, the architect behind the ARK Invest funds, is famously known as a Tesla bull. A Wednesday trading disclosure shows the exchange-traded fund bought more Broadcom stock after buying into the semiconductor company last week. The investment management company also added Broadcom stock to a different fund. Related tickers mentioned: AVGO, TSLA, TSM, TSMWF, ^IXIC.
